items.title: The Added Value of Neural Mobilization Techniques to Proprioceptive Neuromuscular Facilitation in Patients With Adhesive Capsulitis: Randomized Controlled Trial.
items.summary: A randomized controlled trial (n=56) found that combining neural mobilization techniques (NMTs) with proprioceptive neuromuscular facilitation (PNF) and conventional physical therapy led to statistically significant short-term improvements in pain, disability, and passive shoulder ROM in patients with adhesive capsulitis. However, only the 14.08° improvement in shoulder abduction approached the established MCID.
items.curatedReason: 虽然这项 RCT 显示神经松动术联合 PNF 能在统计学上改善肩周炎疼痛、功能障碍和 ROM，但除肩外展 ROM 外，其他结果均未达到临床最小重要差异 (MCID)。这意味着多数改善的临床意义有限。
items.titleZh: 神经松动术联合本体感受神经肌肉促进技术对肩周炎患者的附加价值：一项随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项随机对照试验 (n=56) 显示，神经松动术联合本体感受神经肌肉促进技术 (PNF) 和常规物理治疗，能统计学显著地在短期内改善肩周炎患者的疼痛、功能障碍和肩关节被动活动度。但仅肩外展改善 14.08° 接近临床最小重要差异 (MCID)。
items.curatedReasonEn: While this RCT showed statistically significant improvements in pain, disability, and ROM for adhesive capsulitis with neural mobilization plus PNF, most outcomes, except shoulder abduction ROM, did not meet the minimal clinically important difference (MCID). This suggests limited clinical meaningfulness for most observed improvements.
items.limitation: 研究样本量较小 (n=56)，随访时间仅 6 周，且多数结局指标的组间差异未达到临床最小重要差异 (MCID)，限制了结果的长期外推性与临床意义。
items.limitationEn: The study has a small sample size (n=56) and a short follow-up of only 6 weeks, and most outcome measures' between-group differences did not reach the MCID, limiting long-term generalizability and clinical significance.
items.journal: Physiotherapy research international : the journal for researchers and clinicians in physical therapy

items.title: Effects of High-Intensity Laser Therapy on Functional Outcomes and Spasticity-Related Pain in Subacute and Chronic Stroke Patients with Plantar Flexor Spasticity: A Randomized Sham-Controlled Trial.
items.summary: A randomized sham-controlled trial (N=24) found high-intensity laser therapy (HILT) significantly reduced spasticity-related pain (P<0.001) and showed a covariate-adjusted gait speed benefit (0.089 m/s, 95% CI 0.003-0.176; P=0.043) in subacute/chronic stroke patients with plantar flexor spasticity, when combined with conventional rehabilitation.
items.curatedReason: 高强度激光（HILT）作为卒中后足底屈肌痉挛的辅助疗法，对缓解疼痛有效。它在改善步态方面有统计学益处，但临床意义尚待更大样本验证，别急于将其作为主要步态干预。
items.titleZh: 高强度激光疗法对亚急性和慢性卒中患者足底屈肌痉挛引起的功能结局和痉挛相关疼痛的影响：一项随机假对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项随机假对照试验（N=24）发现，高强度激光疗法（HILT）结合常规康复，能显著减轻亚急性及慢性卒中患者足底屈肌痉挛相关的疼痛（P<0.001），并显示出协变量调整后的步态速度改善（0.089 m/s，95% CI 0.003-0.176；P=0.043）。
items.curatedReasonEn: High-intensity laser therapy (HILT) is effective for pain relief as an adjunct in subacute and chronic stroke patients with plantar flexor spasticity. While it showed a statistical gait benefit, its clinical significance requires larger trials, so avoid prioritizing it as a primary gait intervention.
items.limitation: 这是一项初步的小样本试验，步态改善的临床意义尚不明确，且未报告长期随访数据。
items.limitationEn: This is a preliminary trial with a small sample size, and the clinical significance of gait improvement remains unclear; long-term follow-up data were not reported.
items.journal: American journal of physical medicine & rehabilitation

items.title: When evidence fails in real life: Rethinking sports injury rehabilitation and prevention.
items.summary: This commentary critically examines traditional linear, reductionist models in sports injury prevention and rehabilitation, advocating for an integrated, complexity-informed framework that incorporates dynamic biopsychosocial thinking and a comprehensive interpretation of evidence-based practice to enhance patient-centered care.
items.curatedReason: 传统运动损伤康复和预防的线性还原论方法有局限性。要开始用复杂系统思维、动态生物心理社会模型和整合性循证实践框架来审视你的临床决策，这能帮你更好地适应运动员的真实需求，提高康复效果。
items.titleZh: 当证据在现实生活中失效：重新思考运动损伤的康复与预防
items.summaryZh: 这篇述评批判性地审视了运动损伤预防与康复中传统的线性、还原论模型，主张采用整合的、复杂性导向的框架，该框架结合了动态的生物心理社会思维和对循证实践的全面解读，以提升以患者为中心的护理。
items.curatedReasonEn: Traditional linear, reductionist approaches to sports injury rehab and prevention have limitations. Start incorporating complexity science, a dynamic biopsychosocial model, and an integrative evidence-based practice framework into your clinical decisions to better adapt to athletes' real-world needs and improve outcomes.

items.title: Physical dependence, self-efficacy, and resilience in stroke patients: a double-moderated mediation model of healthcare group and pre-stroke employment.
items.summary: A cross-sectional study (N=123) found physical dependence was concurrently associated with lower resilience in stroke patients, partially mediated by self-efficacy. This conditional indirect pathway was significant among patients receiving routine care who were unemployed pre-stroke.
items.curatedReason: 这项观察性研究提示，卒中患者的身体依赖性可能与韧性（resilience）下降有关，其中自我效能感是部分中介因素。尤其关注那些卒中前失业且接受常规护理的患者；他们可能更需要支持，才能更好地适应卒中后的生活。
items.titleZh: 卒中患者的身体依赖性、自我效能和韧性：一项医疗组和卒中前就业状况双重调节的中介模型
items.summaryZh: 一项横断面研究（N=123）发现，卒中患者的身体依赖性与较低的韧性同时相关，其中自我效能感是部分中介因素。这种有条件的间接路径在接受常规护理且卒中前失业的患者中尤为显著。
items.curatedReasonEn: This observational study suggests that physical dependence in stroke patients may be linked to lower resilience, partially mediated by self-efficacy. Pay particular attention to patients who were unemployed pre-stroke and receiving routine care; they may need more support to adapt to life after stroke.
items.limitation: 这是一项横断面研究，无法建立因果关系，且样本量较小。
items.limitationEn: This is a cross-sectional study, which precludes causal inference, and involved a relatively small sample size.

items.title: Effect of Sequential Electroacupuncture Combined With Augmented Reality Gait Training on Walking Function and Neuromuscular Control in Subacute Stroke: A Randomized Controlled Trial.
items.summary: A 4-week randomized controlled trial (n=40) in subacute stroke patients found that sequential electroacupuncture combined with augmented reality gait training significantly improved gait speed (P=0.011), stride length, gait symmetry, motor function, and balance compared to augmented reality alone.
items.curatedReason: 这项 RCT 提示，对于亚急性卒中患者，在增强现实步态训练前进行序贯电针治疗，能显著改善步速、步幅、步态对称性、运动功能和平衡。可以考虑将其作为现有 AR 步态训练的增效手段，但需留意其机制尚待进一步研究。
items.titleZh: 序贯电针联合增强现实步态训练对亚急性卒中患者步行功能和神经肌肉控制的影响：一项随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 40 名亚急性卒中患者的 4 周随机对照试验发现，序贯电针联合增强现实步态训练显著改善了步速（P=0.011）、步幅、步态对称性、运动功能和平衡，优于单独的增强现实训练。
items.curatedReasonEn: This RCT suggests that sequential electroacupuncture prior to augmented reality gait training significantly improves gait speed, stride length, symmetry, motor function, and balance in subacute stroke patients. Consider this as an augmenting strategy for existing AR gait training, while noting its mechanisms require further investigation.
items.limitation: 本研究为单盲设计，且样本量相对较小（n=40），结果推广需谨慎。
items.limitationEn: This study used a single-blind design and had a relatively small sample size (n=40), so the generalizability of the findings should be interpreted with caution.
items.journal: American journal of physical medicine & rehabilitation

items.title: Quantitative evaluation of shoulder motor compensation in stroke patients based on multimodal feature analysis.
items.summary: A study with 25 stroke patients demonstrated that integrating markerless motion capture with sEMG provides objective metrics for shoulder motor compensation, with maximum joint angle (ρ = 0.932, p < 0.001) and median frequency of sEMG (ρ = 0.806, p < 0.001) showing strong correlations with clinical scores.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究提出了一种基于无标记运动捕捉和表面肌电图的肩部运动代偿量化评估方法。如果你正在探索更客观、简化的卒中上肢功能评估工具，这为补充传统主观量表提供了一个有前景的思路。
items.titleZh: 基于多模态特征分析的卒中患者肩部运动代偿定量评估
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 25 名卒中患者的研究表明，结合无标记运动捕捉和表面肌电图能提供肩部运动代偿的客观指标，最大关节角度（ρ = 0.932, p < 0.001）和肌电图中位频率（ρ = 0.806, p < 0.001）与临床评分强相关。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study presents a quantitative method for assessing shoulder motor compensation using markerless motion capture and sEMG. If you're exploring more objective, simplified tools for upper limb function in stroke, this offers a promising approach to complement traditional subjective scales.
items.limitation: 本研究为观察性设计，仅在特定任务中评估了肩部功能，且样本量较小（n=25），外推性受限。
items.limitationEn: This observational study evaluated shoulder function only during a specific task with a small sample size (n=25), limiting generalizability.
items.journal: Journal of electromyography and kinesiology : official journal of the International Society of Electrophysiological Kinesiology

items.title: Addressing stroke family caregivers' mental health through person‑ and family‑centred rehabilitation.
items.summary: This review highlights that stroke family caregivers are at increased risk for adverse mental health outcomes and suggests that person- and family-centred care (PFCC) is a promising approach to integrate caregiver support into rehabilitation, recognizing them as key team members.
items.curatedReason: 卒中家庭照护者面临显著的精神健康风险。本综述强调了以人为本和以家庭为中心（PFCC）的康复模式在支持照护者方面的潜力。它提醒你，在卒中康复中，应将照护者视为康复团队的关键成员，并定期评估他们的需求，提供持续的教育、培训和支持。
items.titleZh: 通过以人为本和以家庭为中心的康复解决卒中家庭照护者的心理健康问题
items.summaryZh: 本综述指出卒中家庭照护者面临精神健康风险，并提出以人为本和以家庭为中心（PFCC）的康复模式，能将照护者作为关键团队成员纳入康复过程，有望改善其心理健康和福祉。
items.curatedReasonEn: Stroke family caregivers face significant mental health risks. This review highlights the potential of Person- and Family-Centred Care (PFCC) in supporting caregivers. It reminds you to recognize caregivers as key rehabilitation team members in stroke care, regularly assess their needs, and provide ongoing education, training, and support.
items.limitation: 本研究为叙述性综述，缺乏系统性评估和数据合成，结论主要基于文献论证。
items.limitationEn: This narrative review lacks systematic appraisal and data synthesis, with conclusions primarily based on literature argumentation.

items.title: Adaptive Sports Introduction During Inpatient Rehabilitation: A Descriptive Study.
items.summary: A cross-sectional study of 100 inpatients with new disabilities found that 43% desired exposure to adaptive sports during their admission, with younger age and pre-admission sports participation positively correlating with this desire.
items.curatedReason: 新发残疾患者对住院期间接触适应性运动有强烈兴趣。这对你的团队有启发：应考虑在早期康复阶段提供适应性运动介绍，并由多学科团队成员共同推进，以提高参与度。
items.titleZh: 住院康复期间适应性运动的引入：一项描述性研究
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 100 名新发残疾住院患者的横断面研究发现，43% 的患者希望在住院期间接触适应性运动，其中年龄较轻和入院前有运动参与者对此意愿更强。
items.curatedReasonEn: Patients with new disabilities show significant interest in adaptive sports during inpatient rehabilitation. This suggests that your team should consider integrating adaptive sports introductions early in rehabilitation, leveraging a multidisciplinary approach to optimize exposure and participation.
items.limitation: 本研究为横断面描述性设计，仅能提示相关性，无法确立因果关系。
items.limitationEn: This cross-sectional descriptive study can only suggest correlations, not establish causality.
items.journal: American journal of physical medicine & rehabilitation

items.title: Study Protocol for a Randomized Controlled Trial Comparing Swiss Ball Balance Training and Conventional Balance Training to Improve Trunk Control and Mobility in Individuals with Sub acute Stroke.
items.summary: This study protocol describes a randomized, assessor-blinded, crossover trial to compare the effects of 6-week Swiss ball balance training versus conventional balance training on trunk control, balance, and mobility in individuals with subacute stroke in Sub-Saharan Africa.
items.curatedReason: 这项 RCT 方案旨在比较瑞士球平衡训练与传统平衡训练对亚急性卒中患者躯干控制、平衡和活动能力的影响。在正式结果公布前，值得我们思考如何在卒中康复中引入动态且需要核心参与的训练，但请记住，这目前仍停留在方案阶段。
items.titleZh: 一项比较瑞士球平衡训练与传统平衡训练以改善亚急性卒中患者躯干控制和活动能力的随机对照试验研究方案
items.summaryZh: 本研究方案描述了一项随机、评估者设盲、交叉试验，旨在比较为期 6 周的瑞士球平衡训练与传统平衡训练对撒哈拉以南非洲亚急性卒中患者躯干控制、平衡和活动能力的影响。
items.curatedReasonEn: This RCT protocol will compare Swiss ball balance training with conventional balance training for trunk control, balance, and mobility in subacute stroke. Before the definitive results are published, consider how dynamic, core-engaging exercises might integrate into stroke rehab, but remember, this is currently just a protocol.

items.title: CMS Adds Medicare Options to Help People Manage Substance Use Disorder, Heart Failure, and Other Common Chronic Conditions
items.summary: CMS is expanding its Advancing Chronic Care with Effective, Scalable Solutions (ACCESS) Model to include technology-supported care options for Medicare beneficiaries with heart failure, COPD, substance use disorders, nicotine dependence, and expanded support for chronic musculoskeletal pain, starting in spring 2027. The model ties payments to measurable improvements in patient health.
items.curatedReason: 从 2027 年春季开始，美国 CMS 将通过 ACCESS 模型扩展对心力衰竭、COPD、物质使用障碍及慢性肌肉骨骼疼痛患者的 Medicare 远程护理选项。这意味着你在这些领域为 Medicare 患者提供基于技术的居家康复服务将有新的报销途径，密切关注实施细则，这会影响你未来的服务模式和收入。
items.titleZh: CMS 增加 Medicare 选项以帮助患者管理物质使用障碍、心力衰竭及其他常见慢性病
items.summaryZh: CMS 将通过其“推进慢性病有效可扩展解决方案（ACCESS）”模型，扩展对 Medicare 受益人的技术支持护理选项，涵盖心力衰竭、COPD、物质使用障碍、尼古丁依赖以及慢性肌肉骨骼疼痛的扩展支持，预计于 2027 年春季启动。该模型将支付与患者健康的可衡量改善挂钩。
items.curatedReasonEn: Starting in spring 2027, CMS will expand Medicare's technology-supported home care options for patients with heart failure, COPD, substance use disorder, and chronic musculoskeletal pain through the ACCESS Model. This implies new reimbursement avenues for you to provide technology-enabled home rehabilitation services to Medicare patients in these areas. Closely monitor implementation details, as this will impact your future service models and revenue.

items.title:
Associations between interpreter dependency and rehabilitation outcomes and care processes following acquired brain injury: a Swedish registry-based cohort study
							| Journal of Rehabilitation Medicine
items.summary: A Swedish registry-based cohort study of 13,900 inpatients with acquired brain injury found that interpreter dependency was associated with lower functional independence, health-related quality of life, and self-perceived health scores at admission and discharge, though not with the degree of improvement.
items.curatedReason: 语言障碍是脑损伤康复中被忽视的关键因素。该研究表明，口译依赖型患者在功能独立性、生活质量和自我感知健康方面表现更差，提示在制定康复计划时，除了临床因素，还应考虑患者的语言支持需求。
items.titleZh: 口译依赖与脑损伤康复结果及护理过程的关联：一项瑞典注册回顾性队列研究
items.summaryZh: 一项对 13,900 名脑损伤住院患者进行的瑞典注册回顾性队列研究发现，口译依赖与入院及出院时较低的功能独立性、健康相关生活质量和自我感知健康评分相关，但与这些结果的改善程度无关。
items.curatedReasonEn: Language barriers are a critical yet often overlooked factor in brain injury rehabilitation. This study indicates that interpreter-dependent patients experience poorer outcomes in functional independence, quality of life, and self-perceived health, suggesting that rehabilitation planning should integrate language support needs alongside clinical factors.
items.limitation: 这项回顾性队列研究可能存在未测量混杂因素（如脑损伤严重程度或早期护理差异）的影响。
items.limitationEn: This retrospective cohort study may be influenced by unmeasured confounders, such as injury severity or disparities in earlier care.

items.title: Cost-utility of non-pharmacologic interventions aimed at improving cognitive outcomes after traumatic brain injury in older adulthood from the Ontario public healthcare payer perspective
items.summary: A cost-utility analysis in Ontario, Canada, found that combination therapy (physical rehabilitation and cognitive training) yielded the highest quality-adjusted life years (3.04 QALYs) and net monetary benefits (CAD$102,653) for improving cognitive outcomes in older adults (≥ 65 years) following traumatic brain injury, with an ICER of CAD$18,028 per QALY.
items.curatedReason: 对老年创伤性脑损伤（TBI）患者来说，物理康复联合认知训练是改善认知结局最具成本效益的非药物干预措施。这为你在向安大略省的支付方推介 TBI 老年患者的综合康复方案时，提供了强有力的经济学证据支持。
items.titleZh: 从安大略省公共医疗支付方角度看，旨在改善老年创伤性脑损伤认知结局的非药物干预措施的成本效益
items.summaryZh: 一项针对加拿大安大略省的成本效益分析发现，对于老年（≥ 65 岁）创伤性脑损伤患者，物理康复与认知训练的联合疗法在改善认知结局方面产生了最高的质量调整生命年（3.04 QALYs）和净货币收益（102,653 加元），增量成本效益比为 18,028 加元/QALY。
items.curatedReasonEn: For older adults with traumatic brain injury (TBI), combined physical rehabilitation and cognitive training is the most cost-effective non-pharmacologic intervention to improve cognitive outcomes. This provides strong economic evidence to support your advocacy for integrated rehabilitation programs for older TBI patients when dealing with payers in Ontario.
items.limitation: 本研究为成本效益分析，其结果依赖于模型假设和输入参数，可能与现实世界数据存在偏差。
items.limitationEn: This cost-utility analysis relies on model assumptions and input parameters, which may differ from real-world data.

items.title: The effects of an enriched tennis program on the executive functions and motor skills of preschool children
items.summary: An 8-week enriched tennis program featuring open-skill activities significantly improved inhibitory control (p = .008, ηp2 = .184) and tennis-specific motor skills (forehand p = .001, ηp2 = .259; ball control p = .006, ηp2 = .200) in preschool children, compared to a control group with closed-skill activities.
items.curatedReason: 这项 RCT 显示，为期 8 周的开放技能网球课程能有效改善学龄前儿童的抑制性控制和网球专项运动技能。这提示你在早期干预中，融入这类强调认知参与的动态开放技能活动，有助于提升儿童的运动与认知发展。
items.titleZh: 丰富网球课程对学龄前儿童执行功能和运动技能的影响
items.summaryZh: 一项为期 8 周的丰富网球课程（包含开放技能活动）显著改善了学龄前儿童的抑制性控制（p = .008, ηp2 = .184）和网球专项运动技能（正手 p = .001, ηp2 = .259；控球 p = .006, ηp2 = .200），相较于仅进行封闭技能活动的对照组。
items.curatedReasonEn: This RCT demonstrates that an 8-week open-skill tennis program can effectively improve inhibitory control and tennis-specific motor skills in preschool children. This suggests that incorporating dynamic, open-skill activities that emphasize cognitive engagement into early interventions can enhance children's motor and cognitive development.
items.limitation: 研究样本量较小，且干预组和对照组在年龄上存在微小差异。
items.limitationEn: The study has a small sample size, and there was a minor age difference between the intervention and control groups.

items.title: Exercise snacking as a novel strategy for prevention and intervention of frailty in older adults: a scoping review
items.summary: A scoping review of 16 studies found that "exercise snacking" is a safe and promising strategy for frailty prevention and intervention in older adults, improving physical function (muscle strength, balance, mobility) and adherence, with most studies being (pilot) RCTs published since 2022.
items.curatedReason: 这项范围综述确认，碎片化运动（“运动零食”）是老年人衰弱预防和干预的安全有效策略，对提高身体功能、依从性有积极作用。这为你将碎片化运动纳入老年患者的个性化康复计划提供了高等级证据，尤其适用于传统长时间运动受限的患者。
items.titleZh: 碎片化运动作为老年人衰弱预防与干预的新策略：一项范围综述
items.summaryZh: 一项对 16 项研究进行的范围综述发现，碎片化运动（“运动零食”）是老年人衰弱预防和干预的一种安全且有前景的策略，能改善身体功能（肌肉力量、平衡、活动能力）和依从性，其中大多数研究为自 2022 年以来发表的（初步）随机对照试验。
items.curatedReasonEn: This scoping review confirms that "exercise snacking" is a safe and effective strategy for frailty prevention and intervention in older adults, positively impacting physical function and adherence. This provides high-level evidence for integrating exercise snacking into individualized rehabilitation plans for older patients, especially those limited by traditional long-duration exercise.
items.limitation: 纳入研究的设计类型多样（多数为 RCTs），但仍需大规模多中心试验来验证个体化方案的有效性。
items.limitationEn: Although most included studies are RCTs, large-scale multicenter trials are still needed to validate individualized exercise snacking regimens.

items.title: Two-year follow-up of varus progression in young professional football players
items.summary: A two-year follow-up study of 31 adolescent male professional academy football players found that varus progression (increase in mechanical femorotibial axis angle, MAA) was most pronounced in younger athletes and significantly associated with greater increases in height, low initial height, BMI, and less initial varus deformity.
items.curatedReason: 这项针对青少年足球运动员的两年随访研究提示，股胫机械轴角度（MAA）的增加在年轻运动员中更为显著，且与身高和体重增长相关。在制定青少年足球运动员预防方案时，应特别关注生长发育期，早期识别并管理膝内翻风险。
items.titleZh: 青少年职业足球运动员膝内翻进展的两年随访研究
items.summaryZh: 一项对 31 名青少年职业足球运动员的两年随访研究发现，膝内翻进展（股胫机械轴角度增加）在年龄较小的运动员中最为显著，并与身高、初始身高较低、BMI 和初始膝内翻畸形程度较轻的更大增幅显著相关。
items.curatedReasonEn: This two-year follow-up study on young football players suggests that an increase in the mechanical femorotibial axis angle (MAA) is more pronounced in younger athletes and associated with growth in height and weight. When developing preventive strategies for youth football players, prioritize monitoring during growth spurts to identify and manage genu varum risk early.
items.limitation: 本研究为小样本观察性队列，且入组球员均为在观察期内出现膝内翻进展的特定队列，结果外推性有限。
items.limitationEn: This study is a small observational cohort of players specifically showing varus progression, limiting generalizability.
items.journal: BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Evidence-Based Insights for the Development and Talent Promotion of Young Athletes in a National Sports Context
items.summary: This perspective article explores the challenges and opportunities in integrating early talent promotion with sustainable athlete development frameworks, using the Swedish context as a case study. It argues for a nuanced, evidence-based approach that supports both elite performance and broader participation goals, emphasizing athlete well-being and intrinsic motivation.
items.curatedReason: 这份述评基于瑞典的经验，强调了在国家体育背景下，青年运动员的发展与人才培养需要平衡早期精英选拔和长期、包容性发展模式。它提醒你，在推动运动康复和表现训练时，要考量当地文化和组织背景，并兼顾运动员的福祉和广泛参与。
items.titleZh: 在国家体育背景下，青年运动员发展与人才培养的循证见解
items.summaryZh: 这篇述评文章以瑞典为例，探讨了在整合早期人才培养与可持续运动员发展框架方面的挑战与机遇。文章认为，应采取一种细致入微的循证方法，同时支持精英表现和更广泛的参与目标，并强调运动员的福祉和内在动机。
items.curatedReasonEn: Drawing from the Swedish experience, this perspective emphasizes that youth athlete development and talent promotion within a national sports context require balancing early elite selection with long-term, inclusive development models. It reminds you to consider local cultural and organizational contexts and prioritize athlete well-being and broad participation when promoting sports rehabilitation and performance training.
